But they cried the more, Crucifie him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=15}} And Pilate vvilling {{sup|‖}} to {{ls}}atisfie the people, relea{{ls}}ed to them Barabbas, and deliuered {{sc|Iesvs}}, hauing vvhipped him, for to be crucified.

{{verse|chapter=15|verse=16}} And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 19, 2.''}}* the {{ls}}ouldiars led him into the court of the Palace, and they call together the vvhole band: {{verse|chapter=15|verse=17}} and they clothe him in purple, and platting a crovvne of thornes, they put it vpon him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=18}} And they began to {{ls}}alute him, Haile King of the Ievves. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=19}} And they {{ls}}mote his head vvith a reede: and they did {{ls}}pit on him. and bovving the knees, they adored him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=20}} And after they had mocked him, they {{ls}}tripped him of the purple, and put on him his ovvne garments, and they leade him forth to crucifie him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=21}} And they forced a certaine man that pa{{ls}}{{ls}}ed by, Simon a Cyrenêan comming from the countrie, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to take vp his cro{{ls}}{{ls}}e. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=22}} And they bring him into the place Golgotha, vvhich being interpreted is, ''The place of Caluarie''. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=23}} And they gaue him to drinke vvine mingled vvith myrrhe: and he tooke it not.

{{verse|chapter=15|verse=24}} And crucifying him, they deuided his garments, ca{{ls}}ting lottes vpon them, vvho {{ls}}hould take vvhich. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=25}} And it vvas the third houre, and they crucified him. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=26}} And the title of his cau{{ls}}e vvas {{ls}}uper{{ls}}cribed, {{sc|King of the iewes}}. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=27}} And vvith him they crucifie tvvo theeues: one on the right hand, and an other on his left. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=28}} And the Scripture vvas fulfilled that {{ls}}aith, ''And vvith the vvicked he vvas reputed''.{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''E{{ls}}a. 53, 12.''}} {{verse|chapter=15|verse=29}} And they that pa{{ls}}{{ls}}ed by, bla{{ls}}phemed him, vvagging their heades, and {{ls}}aying, Vah, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`thou that de{{ls}}troie{{ls}}t''}}`he that de{{ls}}troieth' the temple, and in three daies {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`builde{{ls}}t''}}`buildeth' it': {{verse|chapter=15|verse=30}} {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ So Heretikes {{ls}}ay of the B.
